data.long_meaning: The name Eluzor is derived from the Hebrew word 'el', meaning 'God', and 'azazel', meaning 'my God is a rock'. In the Old Testament, Azazel is a name for the scapegoat on which the sins of the Israelites were placed during the Day of Atonement. By using the name Eluzor, one can evoke the image of a strong and unwavering faith in God, especially during times of hardship or trial.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes faith and trust in God's unwavering strength and protection.
data.etymology: Eluzor belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “My God is a Rock.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Eluzor total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_hebrew.name: אלוזור
in_hebrew.meaning: אלוהים הוא עוזרי, אלוהים עוזר לי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אלוזור הוא שם שמשמעותו 'אלוהים הוא עוזרי' או 'אלוהים עוזר לי'. השם מורכב משתי מילים: 'אל' - האל, ו'עוזור' - עוזר. השם אלוזור הוא שם שמקורו בתנ"ך ומשקף את הקשר בין האדם לאלוהים, תוך שימת דגש על עזרתו וסיועו של האל בקשיים ובצרויות.

in_greek.name: Ἠλούζορ
in_greek.meaning: Ο Θεός είναι ο βοηθός μου
in_greek.long_meaning: Ἠλούζορ σημαίνει 'Ο Θεός είναι ο βοηθός μου' ἤ 'Ο Θεός με βοηθά'. Τὸ ὄνομα προέρχεται ἀπὸ τὶς Ἑβραϊκὴ λέξη καὶ ἀποτελεῖται ἀπὸ δύο λέξεις: 'Ἠλ' - ὁ Θεός, καὶ 'ουζορ' - βοηθός. Στὴν Καινή Διαθήκη, ὁ Ἠλούζορ ἀναφέρεται ὡς ὄνομα ποὺ ἐκφράζει τὴν πίστη καὶ τὴν ἐλπίδα στὸ Θεὸ ὡς βοηθό.

in_latin.name: Eluzor
in_latin.long_meaning: Eluzor nomen est quod significat 'Deus est adiutor meus' vel 'Deus mihi adiuvat'. Nomen hebraicum est et componitur ex duabus vocibus: 'El' - Deus, et 'uzor' - adiutor. In Ecclesia primitiva, nomen Eluzor fuit usitatum ut exprimere relationem inter hominem et Deum, sublineando auxilium et supportationem Dei in difficultatibus et tribulationibus.

in_english.meaning: God is my helper or God helps me

Throughout Christian tradition, Eluzor has been used to express faith and reliance on God's assistance and support during trials and hardships. The name holds spiritual significance as a reminder of divine providence and guidance.
